description: This file implements the frontend page for defect management in a manufacturing defect tracking system. It includes UI components to list, search, filter, and create defect entries, managing state and calling API endpoints.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Fetches the list of defects from the API based on current filters and updates the component state.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Handles the submission of the new defect form, calls API to create a defect, and refreshes the defect list.
